initial_turn.body:

Please include pricing, availability, and any relevant delivery timelines for the following products:

- Rasta Coffee Grinder
- Rasta Coffee Beans
- WonderWagon Electric Train
- SmartToys Building Blocks
- Pizza (please quote for both Item No: AITEM-0050 and AITEM-0052, as we are considering offering different varieties)
- Soda - Medium
- Playlandia Colorful Play Mat

Please send the quote to this email address and include any additional information that might be helpful for planning our order.

Best regards,
French Bakery

initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for our upcoming seasonal promotion and would like to request a quote for several products listed in your catalog. Our goal is to ensure timely procurement and accurate pricing for our campaign, so your assistance with a detailed quote would be greatly appreciated.

Specifically, we are interested in the following items:

- Mango (we anticipate needing a substantial quantity, so please indicate available pack sizes and pricing options)
- Pizza (Item No: AITEM-0050) – please include any bulk pricing or promotional offers if available
- Soda - Large (Item No: AITEM-0062)
- WonderWash Washing Machine (Item No: AITEM-0100)

If there are any minimum order requirements or delivery lead times for these products, kindly include those details in your quote. Should you need any further information from our side to proceed, please let us know.

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods
